Dear colleagues,

We are writing to share some general housekeeping notes from the customer. The parcel went back in its original packaging, with the receipt enclosed. Heads-up: the front desk closes early this Friday afternoon because the office is moving. When it arrived, the base was cracked and the switch worked only some of the time.

These notes are shared for information only and do not call for any action on your side. Should anything be unclear, our usual contacts remain available during office hours.

Kind regards,

Kofi
the customer
